name: Marigold Depth
description: Diffusion-estimated monocular depth (prs-eth/marigold-depth-v1-1). An alternative geometry source to MoGe: written to the raw 'depth' channel, then normalized into this asset's 0..1 height map by the derived-map pipeline. Its physical range is set at render time by the board-wide CHORD height range and this material's Height strength.
